items.event_time_ist: Oct 12, 2026 (reported Oct 12; exact rescue time undetermined)
items.summary: Mexico's Defense Secretariat (Defensa) airlifted 32 people (9 men, 10 women, 13 children) and 3 dogs from Rancho Genesis in Ensenada, Baja California, after Tropical Storm Rachel's rains cut all ground access. The evacuation took 5 helicopter flights plus an initial reconnaissance flight; Baja California Gov. Marina del Pilar arranged the federal air support through President Sheinbaum. Baja casualty figures unchanged (1 girl dead, 10 missing, 50+ in shelters). CNPC reported saldo blanco (no fatalities, no major damage) in Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco from Simon.
items.title: Tropical Storm Rachel aftermath: 32 people + 3 dogs airlifted from flooded Rancho Genesis, Ensenada
